title: The 25 Best K-Pop Albums of 2026 (So Far), Ranked: Staff Picks
summary: From BTS' chart-dominating ARIRANG to standouts from SHINee, AKMU, Yves, NMIXX and more, see which album takes the No. 1 spot.
contentText:
At the halfway point of 2026, albums from the K-pop scene have rewritten history for new chart records while also delivering projects to expand the scope of Korea’s music scene.

Since the start of the year, it feels like there has not been a month without a major blockbuster release or highly anticipated comebacks where artists stepped up to high stakes put upon them. While BTS ‘ ARIRANG spent multiple weeks at No. 1 atop the Billboard 200 (and set several new sales records while at it), the larger context behind the group’s full-length return showed the importance of an artist creatively pushing themselves and not falling back to what worked in past victories. Artists who scored breakout years in 2025, including NMIXX , Yves, WOODZ, idntt, XLOV and XngHan&Xoul, all ensured their next releases would not disappoint as fresh rookies like LNGSHOT and HEART OF WOMAN didn’t hold back with bold projects to earn themselves a place in the K-pop conversation.

Perhaps more than ever in past years’ lists, K-pop showed the different ways it’s expanding, with independent acts like AKMU , can’t be blue, Yves and Balming Tiger as well as K-pop mainstays all making their marks in major ways without sacrificing any artistic integrity. Some acts blending their style into the larger K-pop world (can’t be blue collaborated with XngHan and Stray Kids member HAN this year as PLAVE enlisted singer SOLE for their first release with a feature), looking outward to expand a message (Yves enlisted Lolo Zouaï and Lexie Liu as collaborators her EP) or doing it fully on their own (AKMU, Balming Tiger and Billlie all crafted ambitious, full-length projects without any guest features).

Spanning girl groups and boy bands to rock acts and soloists, these are the albums from the larger K-pop industry that have resonated and stayed with our staff the most in 2026 so far.
